comment: C-first source correction after watchman attempts lacked MON_WEP. In makemon.c:m_initweap, mercenary PM_CAPTAIN always receives a long sword or silver saber, unlike the conditional weapon for PM_WATCHMAN/PM_SOLDIER. Dismiss the nine C-observed level-up pages, wish and wield +5 bullwhip at slot i (confirmed by C), spawn the hostile captain, reveal its C position, and apply the whip. Count only if C confirms the weapon is actually wielded and reaches the successful disarm/extraction branch.
